syn: EC's 1950-1954 horror anthology hosted by the Old Witch, with Graham Ingels' ghoulish art and Gaines and Feldstein's twist-ending tales.

syn: Marv Wolfman and George Pérez's 1985 twelve-issue maxi-series that destroyed DC's Multiverse, killed Supergirl and Barry Allen, and rebooted the line.

syn: Hawkman's first series (1964-1968), Gardner Fox and Murphy Anderson's Silver Age Thanagarian police couple; our files also hold Geoff Johns' 2002 run.

J.M. DeMatteis and Ryan Sook's 2001 Spectre, with Hal Jordan as the Spirit of Vengeance seeking redemption; our files also hold Ostrander's run.
Leah Williams' 2024 four-issue Gotham City Sirens reunion of Harley Quinn, Poison Ivy and Catwoman; files also hold Paul Dini's 2009 series.
Jackson Lanzing, Collin Kelly and Roger Cruz's 2024 Outsiders: Luke Fox, Kate Kane and Drummer explore the DC multiverse's hidden history, a Planetary homage.
Tom Taylor's second year of the Injustice prequel: Superman's regime tightens its grip as the Green Lantern Corps arrive to confront him.
J.H. Williams III and W. Haden Blackman's New 52 Batwoman: Kate Kane battles the drowning ghost La Llorona and Medusa in Williams' dazzling layouts.
